description.value: Denny's Kingsway is a 24-hours-a-day Canadian diner franchise along the busy Kingsway corridor in Burnaby, close to Metropolis at Metrotown. The menu spans all-day breakfast, burgers, skillets, and comfort dinners, offering a reliable and familiar refueling option for cyclists at any hour. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available at this location.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 37m. Total: 8 spaces.
